label: Underground spaces
definition: Chambers and passages below ground; distinguish habitation, burial, extraction and storage.

label: Buildings cut from rock
definition: Architecture made by removing bedrock, including free-standing carved structures and cliff facades.

label: Built into natural shelters
definition: Walls and rooms added to existing caves, overhangs and boulders; not all cavities were excavated.

label: Polygonal walls
definition: Many-sided masonry blocks; do not confuse a polygonal room plan with polygonal masonry.

label: Fitted joints
definition: Contact surfaces, corners and connections; a close fit is not a measured tolerance.

label: Single great stones
definition: Individual large worked stones, standing or incorporated into a building; separate moved from unmoved.

label: Quarries & unfinished work
definition: Extraction faces, abandoned cuts and incomplete objects that preserve stages of work.

label: Working marks
definition: Grooves, holes and surface finish; the tool and process require separate evidence.

label: Spanning a space
definition: Lintels, corbelled roofs, arches and vaults: different solutions to carrying loads over an opening.

label: Water channels
definition: Routes that collect, divert or distribute water; carved grooves alone do not establish function.

label: Wells & reservoirs
definition: Accessing and holding water, including ritual settings; keep water supply and sacred purpose distinct.

label: Terraces & shaped ground
definition: Retaining, levelling and reshaping land; agricultural, residential and ceremonial uses differ.

label: Homes & provisioning
definition: Rooms, hearths, stores and production spaces that show everyday life and upkeep.

label: Walls & gateways
definition: Enclosures and controlled entrances; not every wall is defensive.

label: Routes & crossings
definition: Roads, bridges, causeways and cut paths connecting places.

label: Places to gather
definition: Courtyards, plazas, theatres and assembly spaces; identify local functions and periods.

label: Burial spaces
definition: Graves, tombs and cemeteries, with distinct local practices rather than a universal belief system.

label: Images in stone
definition: Reliefs, statues and rock art; keep deliberate imagery separate from production marks.

label: Writing & records
definition: Inscriptions and written signs whose content may identify people, events or dedication.

label: Standing stones
definition: Uprights and rows whose arrangement matters beyond the size of any individual stone.

label: Circles & enclosures
definition: Circular settings and their entrances, interiors and surrounding landscape; no automatic calendar claim.

label: Marks across the landscape
definition: Large ground figures, earthworks and layouts; do not assume a viewing height or purpose.

label: Sun, sky & orientation
definition: Documented alignments or light effects; intentional astronomy needs evidence beyond an attractive bearing.

label: Rebuilding & reuse
definition: Successive additions, repairs and changed uses; sequence requires context, not a ranking of workmanship.
